issuer: the Nevada Department of Motor Vehicles (DMV)
note: The DMV's fee page (read 2026-10-30) gives an original 8-year non-commercial licence, age 64 and under, at $41.50, and says most licences are valid for eight years; an original ID card, ages 18 to 64, is $21.50, and the same page prices its renewal for 8 years, so the card is kept as 8 years (the original card's own term isn't printed beside it). The ID card page gives the youngest age, 10. The teen page says a licence issued under 18 is a minor's licence, printed with the 18th birthday and cancellable by a parent until then, so a full licence is kept from 18. Not held: the 4-year licences from 65 and for limited terms, the $11.50 card from 65.

sources.title: Nevada DMV, Driver License/ID Fees and Exemptions
sources.said: Most driver licenses are valid for eight years. ... Original 8-Year Non-Commercial License $41.50 ... Original $21.50 Renewal or Duplicate (8 Year) $21.50

sources.title: Nevada DMV, Teen Driving: Get Your License
sources.said: 18th birthday printed in red for easy ID by law enforcement and retailers ... may cancel a minor’s license at any time before the driver turns 18.
